deviations.claim_in_article: Meta executives admitted that starting the test without a proper explanation was a mistake.
deviations.issue: The article attributes the admission to Meta executives, while the Ledger identifies the speaker as the vice president of Meta’s Superintelligence Labs. The Japanese source already broadens the attribution.
deviations.explanation: The reported admitting party is broadened from the identified vice president to Meta executives. This is an attribution/scope change, though the source and article retain the same general account.

deviations.claim_in_article: They also temporarily put back the feature in which humans handled the calls.
deviations.issue: “Put back” says the human-call feature was restored, whereas the Ledger says Meta rolled it back.
deviations.explanation: The article reverses the reported action: Meta rolled back the human-concierge feature rather than restoring it. The Japanese source says it was rolled back, so this reversal arose in translation.
